findings.reason: the node's entire check 3 depends on an input the plan never establishes it holds, so a worker either blocks on finding one or substitutes an equilibrium of its own choosing, and the plan is the semantic authority that should name it.
findings.text: check 3 now measures "a reconstruction-style presentation ... agrees within relative 1e-3 with the plant its own equilibrium gives through the generic path", where the reference is "an ITER equilibrium from a code whose flux functions agree with its flux map at the edge", "chosen by measuring that agreement, not assumed"; §6 names no code, no pulse and no existing artefact for that equilibrium, and states no threshold for the edge agreement that would make the 1e-3 plant tolerance reachable, while every other check in the plan names its data (DINA 105069/3, DINA 105013/1, the pinned plant entry, a MAST reconstruction)

findings.reason: as written the plan asserts both that this operation moves DINA by more than check 3's tolerance and that it measured 1.2e-4, so a node cannot tell which quantity to reproduce or whether DINA was in fact excluded on a valid measure.
findings.text: the exclusion of DINA rests on "On DINA 105014/1, withholding the separatrix moved the dominant passive modes by 1.0 to 1.3e-3", but §5's landed record for the same case measures that same presentation change at 1.163e-05 on the section flux and 1.163e-04 on the modal projection, passing the predeclared 1e-3 (`docs/evidence/fragments/iter-passive-plasma-circuit/reconstructed-plasma-plant.html`), and §6 never defines "the dominant passive modes" or says whether its figure is the reduced or the full machine

findings.reason: the rewritten check reports success on the unfixed code, so §6's only discriminating measure is check 2's zero-build counter, and a node that sees check 3 green will believe the reconstruction arm on the full machine has been demonstrated when nothing in that check shows it.
findings.text: check 3's two arms are the reference equilibrium's generic-path plant and its reconstruction-style plant, both assembled from the same sectioned set, so on the code before this change (the negative control's red arm is a base-revision run) both arms still agree within 1e-3 and check 3 passes; the previous formulation it replaced — "§5's reconstruction-style presentation of 105014/1 runs on the full machine instead of the reduced one" — failed on that code because the full-machine run was impossible
